# Influencer Orbit

> Influencer Orbit is a creator seeding operation for US DTC skincare, cosmetics and beauty brands. Founded by Tayyab Habib, it runs confirm-first gifted product seeding, UGC for ads, paid creator collabs and Spark Ads setup on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. A 4-person remote team has run 2,000+ creator collaborations (2,483 posts live for one brand since January 2024) and coordinates 200+ product shipments a month, with clients across the US, UK and EU and creators across the US, Southeast Asia, the UK, Australia and the UAE. Its confirm-first method gets 70%+ of gifted creators to post, against 30% to 50% for typical cold gifting.

## Key facts
- What: done-for-you creator seeding (gifted product seeding, UGC for ads, paid creator collabs, Spark Ads and whitelisting setup)
- Who for: US DTC skincare, cosmetics and beauty brands doing $500K+ a year with 2 to 50 people, including brands already running 50 to 100+ creator posts a month in-house
- Platforms: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube
- Founder: Tayyab Habib (https://www.linkedin.com/in/tayyab-habib-418a20220/)
- Team: 4 people, fully remote, operating since 2023
- Proof: 2,000+ creator collaborations, 1,000+ creators in network, 100+ brands served, 200+ product shipments a month, clients across the US, UK and EU
- Creators: sourced worldwide for US brands, mostly in the US, Southeast Asia, the UK, Australia and the UAE
- Post rate: 70%+ of confirmed creators post, against 30% to 50% for typical cold gifting (HypeAuditor)
- Case study: Esther Formula (Korean skincare and supplement brand), client since January 2024 (35 months), 50 to 200 creator posts a month (2,483 posts live in total), no in-house influencer manager hired
- Contact: tayyab@influencerorbit.com

## Offer
- Launch: $1,500/month for 50+ creator posts (management cost about $30 per post). Best for: Founder-run brands moving off manual gifting
- Growth: $2,500/month for 100+ creator posts (management cost about $25 per post). Best for: Brands ready to own TikTok search in their niche
- Scale: $3,500/month for 150+, plus paid collab management creator posts (management cost about $23 per post). Best for: Brands replacing or extending a coordinator
- Starts with a 60-day pilot, then month to month
- Guarantee: the tier's monthly post count is live by day 60, or month three is free
- First creator posts usually go live within 21 days
- The brand ships gifted product from its own warehouse; on paid collabs the brand pays creators directly
- Method: confirm-first seeding. No creator receives product until they confirm.
